verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an official MCP server at porkbun.com/mcp that connects Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to the account. It ships as `npx @porkbunllc/mcp-server` with 96 tools covering registration, DNS, hosting and Cloudflare zone moves, with example natural-language prompts, and a probe confirms the MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
